notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch only (requests + bs4, Chrome UA impersonation); robots.txt has no Anthropic/Claude bot disallow and no blanket 'Disallow: /', all category pages returned HTTP 200 with server-rendered HTML including counts, no bot walls encountered, so tiers (b)/(c) were not needed. TREE: built from the union of the homepage mega-menu (Bedding, Sheets, Comforters, Pillows, Bath, Mattress, Loungewear/Apparel, Kids & Baby, Home Decor, Outdoor Living, Sale) and each candidate page's own canonical URL/h1 (Salesforce Commerce Cloud site: many nav slugs like /nav-*, /man-*, /re-* 301/soft-redirect to the same canonical friendly URL - deduped by canonical URL, kept only one record per unique listing URL per project rule). No separate category XML sitemap exists (sitemap_1.xml is a product-detail-only sitemap plus a handful of seasonal marketing collection pages, e.g. fall-florals, hotel-inspired, dorm-essentials - excluded as Collection/Seasonal per rule). QTY: every qty is the '<N> Results' / '<N> Products' count string rendered on that page's own listing header, read directly from the fetched HTML (site's own exact number, no estimation). EXCLUDED and why: Mattress (/mattress - mattress/furniture, not textile); Loungewear/Apparel section (pajamas, robes, all fashion apparel per Apparel/Fashion boundary, including womens-robes/mens-robes - note bath-robes under Bath IS included as genuine bathroom textile); Bath Accessories (/bath-accessories - verified contents are porcelain/ceramic soap dish, tumbler, tissue box, waste basket, vanity tray - decorative bathroom accessories, not textile or storage); Tabletop (/tabletop - 'Table Settings and Serveware', Kitchen & Dining boundary); Furniture, Decorative Accents (/home-accents), Lamps/Lighting, Mirrors, Wallpaper, Wreaths & Botanicals, Holiday collection, Patio Umbrellas, Outdoor Furniture, Outdoor Lighting, Outdoor Dinnerware, Nursery Decor, Kids' Lamps, Kids' Wall Art - all belong to other category tasks per boundary sections; Rug Pads (/rug-pads - padding/hardware accessory, not itself a floor-covering textile, analogous to excluded curtain-rod hardware); Sunbrella brand collection page (/sunbrella-outdoor-pillows-and-cushions - brand/marketing landing page, no product-count evidence found, excluded like other brand facet pages Rifle Paper Co./Stoffer Home/Heather Taylor Home/Villa D'Ascoli); Crib Mattresses (/crib-mattresses - mattress/furniture); size (Twin/Queen/King/etc.), color (White/Gray/Blue/etc.), fabric-weave (Percale/Sateen/Linen/Flannel/Jersey Knit/Organic Cotton/Rayon Bamboo/Garment Washed Cotton Percale under Bedding & Sheets), density (Soft/Medium/Firm), warmth level (Lightweight/All Season/Extra Warm), New Arrivals/Best Sellers/Personalized/Clearance/Sale, and brand pages were treated as attribute filters layered on top of an already-present primary product-type category structure (e.g. Sheet Sets/Flat Sheets/Fitted Sheets/Duvet Covers already define the Sheets structure), not as distinct taxonomy nodes, and were excluded to avoid row explosion from re-listing the same underlying products; by contrast Rugs (Wool/Jute & Sisal/Cotton/Performance/Washable) and Comforters/Pillows fill-type (Down/Down Alternative/Foam & Specialty) were INCLUDED because they are the site's own primary organizing structure for those categories (no separate product-type split exists ahead of them the way it does for Sheets). Parent nodes with valid subcategories (Bedding 737, Sheets 293, Comforters 68, Pillows 36, Bath 131, Towels/all-towels 32, Kitchen and Tabletop Decor and Linens 284, Rugs 305, Kids' Bedding 393, Kids' & Baby Bedding Essentials 27, Kids' Bath 20, Bedding Essentials 102) were emitted as grouping rows only (qty/link null), not as leaf rows, per the Parent Category URL Rule. STORAGE: exhaustive keyword scan of the full mega-menu (storage/organiz/basket/hamper/rack/shelf/closet/wardrobe/drawer/trunk/chest/caddy/container/bin) found no dedicated Storage or Home Organization category anywhere on the site - expected for a bedding/linens specialty retailer. The single hit, 'Product Care & Storage' (/product-care-and-storage, 2 products), mixes one genuine fabric storage bag with one non-storage laundry-care product (wool dryer balls) on the same listing page; recorded as a single LOW-confidence review-queue row rather than fabricating a storage-only count. Duplicates prevented: Duvet Covers, Shams-adjacent Bedding cross-links, Beach Towels, Blankets & Throws, Decorative Pillow Covers, and Pillow Inserts each appear under 2 mega-menu paths (e.g. Bedding dropdown AND the dedicated Sheets/Pillows/Home Decor dropdown, or Bath AND Outdoor Living) but canonicalize to the same URL - recorded once each.
